description.name: Entry
description.text: Causes [Imperil Wind 20% (15s)], grants [Buff Wind 20% (15s)] to all allies, grants [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Serafie], [Apex Rumor Radar Damage Tracker] and [Apex Rumor Radar Level] to the user

description.name: Buff Wind 20% (15s)
description.text: Increases Wind damage dealt by 20%, cumulable

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Serafie
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Apex Rumor Radar (0~2), removed after using Apex Rumor Radar two times

description.name: Apex Rumor Radar Damage Tracker
description.text: Increases Apex Rumor Radar level by 1 after dealing 100001 total damage during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Serafie]

description.name: Apex Rumor Radar Level
description.text: Keeps track of Apex Rumor Radar level (0~1), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Serafie]
